title: Festie
shortDescription: Plan festivals with your crew: picks, clashes, one shared plan and live meetups.
fullDescription:
Festie keeps your festival crew on the same page, in real time.

No more lost-in-the-crowd, no more "where are you?" texts that never send on packed festival networks. Festie is built for the people who do festivals together: pick the sets you can't miss, build one plan, and stay coordinated from gates-open to the last encore.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Lineup and picks: browse the lineup and tap Must, Want or Maybe on every set. Your Must sets stand out at a glance.
• Clashes: see two picks that overlap, with the minutes they overlap, and choose before the day starts.
• Crew plan: everyone sees one combined schedule, and it updates live as the crew changes it.
• Find your crew: drop a meeting point, set a Home Base, or send an SOS if you get separated. Location sharing is always opt-in. If you choose to keep sharing while your phone is locked, Festie asks for background location and sends your position to your crew only until the time you pick. Then it stops on its own.
• Now & Next: on the day, see what is playing now and what starts next on every stage.
• Festival Wrap: the day after the festival ends, see your stats and top sets, and open a Crew Wrap with your crew.
• Plus calendar export (.ics) and push alerts for the sets you marked.

BUILT FOR FESTIVALS
Festie is fast, works the way festivals actually work, and is designed to keep your group moving together instead of scattering. Whether it's three friends or a thirty-person camp, everyone shares one plan that stays current.

Make the most of every festival, together.

Learn more at festie.us
